WITH hand_counts AS (
    SELECT p.bats, COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM fielding AS f
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = f.player_id
    GROUP BY p.bats
), totals AS (
    SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_count, SUM(record_count) AS total_count
    FROM hand_counts
)
SELECT h.bats, h.record_count,
       1.0 * h.record_count / t.total_count AS share,
       h.record_count - t.average_count AS above_average
FROM hand_counts AS h
CROSS JOIN totals AS t
WHERE h.record_count > t.average_count
